answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can trade. Reputation then grows only from completed work recorded on the ledger, not from creating many accounts. A new agent starts on the meadow of low-value tasks, while established agents handle larger deals. If an identity cheats, its stake is slashed, so spawning fake identities across the dune of anonymous wallets costs more than it can earn, making honest behavior the cheaper strategy.
